2026.prashna: निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें :
2026.context: The human nose is capable of detecting an astonishing number of different scents. Our sense of smell is closely linked to our memory and emotions, and smells can evoke powerful emotional responses. The olfactory system is also closely linked to the brain's limbic system, which is responsible for processing emotions and motivations.

sub_questions.iv: What is human nose capable of ?

anuprashna.ii: हमारी सूंघने की क्षमता हमारी भावनाओं से कैसे जुड़ी है?
